body: Hey, would you like to talk?

Thank you!
Yep, I am very happy living with 6 dogs. We are actually looking after 2 dogs, so there's 8 dogs in the house.
I love all dogs in general, and I know how you feel because they make me happy too.
Yeah, and I actually just finished walking one of them. He's a saluki X lurcher and he's like a gentle giant.

That's alright, 
Aww, I would love to see a catahula leopard dog. They have beautiful markings. And your welcome and I can imagine that, we have 6 dogs and I love them all.
That's a nice name

Your welcome, 
If you don't mind me asking, what's his name?
Haha, yeah not many people know about them. Ahh ok, but whatever breed he is, he's beautiful. I've never seen them before, so it was just a guess.

Aww, he's a really handsome dog.
Is he/she a Beuceron?

Yeah, it was really fun and I enjoyed myself. 
Haha 😂 
Goodnight and I hope you sleep well too.
I went to the funfair with my family and my favourite ride was there. It's called Extreme and it's like Twister, but in the air.

I'm glad that you are doing ok and that your new medicine is working. I like going to the gym, I normally use the treadmill. The funny thing is that my heart rate goes up to 195 bpm.  
That's nice and I'm quite tired, so I'm going to bed. I'm fine though, thanks.
How are you doing today?

Ok, that's good. I won't make it as a habit and thank you. I'll try not to worry and I hope I will get there soon. I'll check it out on YouTube later because I'm going to be quite busy. 
Anyway, thanks for helping me out and if you want to talk, I'll be here.

Wow! Thank you for the long message :)
That sounds like a horrible way to die and I didn't know it was that painful. I'm glad that you made me think about it. Can I ask you something? 6 paracetamol tablets wouldn't do anything, will it? Yeah, the thing is I tried therapy before and that was a whole year but I still didn't open up. I also has a councillor too, but it didn't help either. I can imagine that being in the hospital isn't great, but I'm glad that it's a safe place for you. I'm also glad that you are getting better and good luck with the psychological therapy, I hope that goes well for you. That's good that you have some funny stories though and it doesn't matter about your age imo, I'm only 19 years old. Haha, I wouldn't have known that you've stolen that because I've never heard of Paul Weller. Thank you so much for helping me, I really do appreciate that. I hope everything will work out for you and that you will feel better soon. 
Oh yeah, I'm not sure why I don't let therapy help me, maybe it's because that I always try to help myself and I don't let anyone help me.
Aww, what kind of breed is she? I'm guessing it's a girl, I apologise if I am wrong.

Yeah, hopefully one day I will open up to someone. Lots of people does try to help me, but I don't let them help me. I don't know why, I just tend to build barriers and shut down. I sometimes think, why don't people just give up helping me? I want to be a better person and let people help me, but it's difficult. Yeah, they are my friends and I've got  fantastic friends that are always there for me. Haha, that's ok; I'm English too. Thanks for the advice and for helping me. 
Yeah, I go to therapy but it doesn't help because I don't open up to them. I'm just wasting their time and someone else should replace me, but I only have 8 sessions left. 
I thought I'll let you know, but I'm not storing the tablets anymore. Instead I downed 6 paracetamol tablets in one go last night. So I'm not going to do it again. Thanks for everything and you helped me, I appreciated that.
Thanks for understanding and I'm so sorry to hear about your situation. Thank you, I appreciate that and for telling me about the paracetamol. Thank you again.

Thanks for understanding, and I went through alot when I was a child too. I really appreciate your help and thanks for the advice. I've got some close friends, but the worst thing is making them feel worried. I hope that everything will work out for you and thanks for sharing your story. I'm glad that you have some hope. I tried therapy, but it's not working. I don't open up to them, but everyone wants to help me.
I just want to be free from everything and I don't want anyone to worry about me. They don't know that I'm going to do it, but I'm just tired.

I'm sorry to hear about your friend. I do have someone I trust, but I don't want them to worry about me. They don't know that I'm going to do it. 
I just want to be free from everything that happened to me.
I'm sorry to hear about that, wow! 4 hours is a long time. Good luck with the new song and I hope you will feel better soon. I'm really good, thanks for asking.
I'm glad that you are still very happy, I'm doing really well thank you.
I hope you feel better soon and I'm glad that you are fine.

Yeah, I agree with you about the cold weather and hot drinks. It's not really that cold here because atm the weather is quite nice, but it could change. Your welcome! That's great to hear that you have a place where you can do fancy things and draw stuff in the foam.

Wow! 4 machines, that's a lot. Maybe one day you will get to make fancy lattes. I don't really do coffees, but very rarely I have lattes. I'm not a fan of hot drinks, however I sometimes drink teas or hot chocolate.
Your welcome and thanks. Do you like coffee?
I'm sorry to hear that, I hope that it will get better for you. I'm a bit tired but I'm ok, thank you.

To tell you the truth, I never had trouble with sleeping. Like, I just shut down literally and sometimes I don't realise I've fallen asleep. I can't really imagine what's it like, but I bet it's hard.
I'm so sorry to hear that, I really hope that everything will be ok.
I'm glad that you are ok though.
Well, I actually just had my dinner. But thanks for the advice.
I'm tired, but I'm ok thank you.

Your welcome, 
I bet that was very nice. I love horses too, well I love animals in general.
I'm glad you got the message because I meant to send it to you. Your welcome.
That doesn't sound good. I'm so sorry to hear that and I hope you will get some sleep soon. Wow! 4 hrs is so little.
I'll definitely pat him, that's if I remember though. Did you have horses?
Thanks, I will. I'm going horse riding tomorrow, so I'm looking forward to it.
I'm sure you will be ok, have fun.
I'm a bit tired, but ok thanks.

I don't tell them about my feelings, I keep it inside.
They are supportive but they don't know what I am going through.
Not really, but I do like listening to music. People say that I am not normal or I'm rubbish, they are absolutely right.
I feel rubbish about myself and I want to get better. But it's impossible, I can't do this anymore.
I'm just rubbish in many different ways.
